title: Escaping values in single-line log records
notes: Rust 1.100.0 (2026-11-12). Release note, RELEASES.md at 1.100.0, Compatibility Notes: '[Always escape grapheme extenders in `str::escape_debug`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158303)'. The naive version is `format!("{key}=\"{}\"", value.escape_debug())`, which now escapes every combining mark and virama, not only a leading one: `Zoe\u{308}` and Devanagari `\u{915}\u{94d}\u{937}\u{93f}` come out with `\u{...}` escapes. Its old behaviour is shown from source at tag 1.99.0 (library/core/src/str/mod.rs escapes only the first char with ESCAPE_ALL), not by running an older compiler. A `{:?}`-based answer already escaped every grapheme extender before this release, so it fails on any version. On disk: /opt/homebrew/Cellar/rust/1.100.0/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library/core/src/str/mod.rs:3150 shows the new one-line implementation; no note says it changed. Exposure risk: none (PR 158303 merged 2026-08-31).
